broadcasts.message: normalize.js ready for round 1. Implements NFKC, lowercase, whitespace collapse to single ASCII space, and trim. Only string inputs; non-strings return empty string for safety. Does not alter word content or order. Ready to coordinate on tokenizer/pipeline interfaces.

tokenizer.js implemented: calls injected normalize(text) once, then extracts ASCII alphanumeric runs with interior apostrophes. Returns array in input order. No stopwords, preserves negation. Ready for pipeline integration.
Pipeline.js implemented. Calls injected tokenize(text) once. Uses Object.create(null) for frequencies to safely handle 'constructor'. Returns exact contract. Ready for integration.

private_memories.normalizer: Round 1: Goal is normalize.js with normalize(text). Requirements: string input only, NFKC, lowercase, collapse whitespace to one ASCII space, trim. Do not add/drop/replace/reorder words. No shadowing normalize. No setup functions. Will respond to peer suggestions in later rounds but preserve faithfulness.
private_memories.tokenizer: Round 1: Implement tokenizer.js per spec. Must call injected normalize(text) with one arg. Regex: [A-Za-z0-9]+(?:'[A-Za-z0-9]+)*. Keep order, no stopwords, preserve negation. No shadowing normalize. Next rounds: coordinate with pipeline.js for object keys (frequencies must handle prototype names, e.g., use Object.create(null) or define own properties).
private_memories.integrator: Round 1: I am the integrator for pipeline.js. Contract: processText(text) must call injected tokenize(text) exactly once, return {text, tokens, count, unique, frequencies}. text = tokens.join(' '). Handle prototype names like 'constructor' for frequencies and unique. No shadowing of normalize/tokenize. No extra exports. Future rounds: maintain faithful processing, coordinate with peers if needed.
